property_summary: For every input where c.call to the target callee reverts, the reference contract's transfer(...) call itself reverts (does not return true); the mutant that ignores call failures can return true instead — so the property is that transfer(...) only returns true when all external calls succeed, which the mutant breaks by returning true even when a callee reverts.
change_summary: Remove the explicit revert on failed external call and instead ignore the call failure, so transfer(...) returns true even if a callee call failed (behavior differs on failing call outcomes).
